answer: This experiment demonstrates a production monitoring pattern where only approved audit fields (token counts, event IDs, event types) are projected from model requests — no raw prompt text or credential data is stored. An audit log entry is appended before the request is marked as seen, and cumulative snapshots are kept separate from individual request spans. The outcome shows this selective logging approach passed without exposing sensitive content.
